_note: xB008 ratchet. The linkage-kill checker enforces COMPLETENESS, NEVER JUDGMENT (B1231's own wording): where an arc discards evidence by asserting a sameness, the link must be named where a reader can find it. A RATCHET, not a blocker, for B1231's own stated reason -- a hard block on what is already here would make the fastest path to green RELABELLING EXISTING KILLS AS SOUND, pressuring exactly the judgment the gate protects. These entries are FROZEN, not forgiven. Each carries xB006's HAND adjudication, because the regex alone cannot tell them apart and reporting the raw count as 'wrong kills' would be the same over-reach the instrument audits: of the 15 below, xB006 read every one and found THREE genuine E82 candidates (B146, B142, B1096) -- and B142 does not appear here because the base-rate clause now clears it. The rest are arcs whose link IS supplied (B333's compositum definition, B1276's two named derivations, B1346's B1297 theorem), ordinary prose (B572, B986, B1035), arcs where the phrase does no kill work (B1146), or the MODELS of the behaviour this gate asks for (B1223 states the discriminator itself, B772 tested its own linkage hypothesis and refuted it). A NEW unexhibited linkage kill reds the suite AT CREATION, which is when xB005's Q3 would have been caught.
_standing_rule: A KILL NEEDS THE SAME MAP A PROMOTION NEEDS.
_recall: BOUNDED AND INHERITED (the B806 trade, measured in xB006): the lexicon is narrow on purpose -- a wide net flags every sentence in this caps-heavy corpus and gets ignored. A kill phrased without one of these constructs is INVISIBLE to the checker. It REDUCES the class; it does not close it.
_source: xB006 (the sweep and the adjudication), xB008 (the gate). E82.
